hook: Their boat flipped. Seven people were in the water.
narration: Seven people were in the water after their boat flipped near Tampa.
The twenty foot boat was upside down.
A Coast Guard crew from Station St. Petersburg pulled alongside.
Life jackets kept their heads above water, [short pause] and the bright orange helps a crew spot people in the waves.
outcome: All seven were pulled aboard and taken to Port Manatee.
title: Boat flipped near Tampa, 7 in the water
description:
A Coast Guard Station St. Petersburg response boat crew rescued seven people from a capsized 20-foot boat near Delta Cut, Tampa, Florida, on Sept. 21, 2020.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video (U.S. Coast Guard Southeast), via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/766602/coast-guard-rescues-7-capsized-vessel-near-delta-cut-tampa
